issues.where: right half and far terrain toward the upper-right limb
issues.what: ridges and plains are dragged on a diagonal and lose micro-detail before the limb; the same smear is in the native crops on image-06.png, image-07.png, and image-08.png

issues.fix: sharpen the near field and add fine surface variation so the foreground is at least as resolved as the mid-canyon

issues.where: upper-center dust storm and the limb under it
issues.what: the vortex is a smooth paint smear, and the ground beneath the haze is fuzzy rather than sharper rock under a separate soft atmosphere
issues.fix: give the spiral internal structure and keep surface detail distinct from the haze falloff

issues.what: Crater rims and dark landforms smear into long diagonal streaks, losing much more detail than the globe above.
issues.fix: Correct the surface sampling or projection and retain crisp crater rims while letting the terrain soften gradually toward the limb.

issues.where: crops U–V, bright white patch on the lower-right limb
issues.what: The white patch is nearly featureless at its brightest and breaks into fine parallel diagonal streaks with violet fringes. It looks pasted onto the surface.
issues.fix: Recover highlight detail, remove the directional streaking and color fringes, and blend the patch into the neighboring terrain with irregular edges.

issues.where: crop O, ridges and pale traces just right of the main chasm
issues.what: Thin red and green fringes double several high-contrast terrain edges.
issues.fix: Align the color channels and reduce sharpening or chromatic aberration on the surface layer.

issues.what: The closest shadowed rock has noticeably softer, directionally smeared texture compared with the neighboring foreground slopes.
issues.fix: Restore fine rock texture in the shadows without lifting the black level or sharpening the whole frame.
